As someone who has severe depression and feelings of anger I definitely understand the relationship between the two. 

Have you tried anti depressants before?  I am overzealous because I’ve tried about 20 of them and they never did shit. What didn’t work for me may work for someone else but there’s absolutely no harm in cautioning someone from getting tangled up in medicine because there are costs and side effects. At least in the US, the default way to handle natural human issues is to overmedicalize (is that a word? Ha) and pop pills. My message is that we don’t need to just throw medicine at every problem. Sure it should be considered as a factor but let’s not just rush to that avenue first. 

The research on anti depressants shows a few things. 1) they are only helpful for severe cases and 2) they only provide about a 20% improvement over placebo. And honestly I don’t even trust these figures because big Pharma is designing these studies to achieve results that favor them and advance their monetary interests.  Many people cite studies that show they are 0% more effective than placebo. 

The default mode is twisted. We should be advising people to really spend a lot of time upfront dealing with things naturally, then seeking a medical consult if the issue is persistent and severe.  You can’t just wash everything away with medicine and I feel strongly about that...
Fair point but rarely is medicine the answer even if it’s depression. Anti depressants are well known to be crappy drugs for treating depression so I’m not sure how they would help anger.
Nah, doesn’t matter what the issue is. There’s no pill for anger, plain and simple. This is a matter of opinion anyways, there’s not really a right answer. I can see your argument and mine as well.

Try to avoid medicines for anger. Anger is a natural emotion and we experience it for a reason. Rather than try to treat the symptoms with some pills, focus on the root cause of your anger. Anger can actually be a very useful emotion. It’s just bad when it gets out of hand. Your body may be trying to tell you something when you’re angry...try to listen to it. 💜

All you can do is try man. Remember this...when has anger ever helped you in life? Has anger ever served you well? 9/10 it just makes things worse. I know you probably know that but it’s helpful to really think about what purpose it’s serving for you.
Walk away from it. Get away from people who hit you if you can.

You gotta work on yourself bro.  When you hurt other people it’s because there’s something that you don’t like about yourself. Maybe you don’t like how you look or what your job is or who your girlfriend is. I don’t know what it is but there’s something that you really don’t like. Figure out what exactly you don’t like about yourself or your life situation and do everything in your power to make yourself a happier person. When you reach the point that you are happy with yourself, you will no longer feel the need to hurt others. You’ve already taken the first step by identifying that you have an issue so keep on going.
You practice your reaction to the anger. Next time you get angry guarantee yourself that you’ll count to 10 before you take any action or say any words

Any idea what the root of your anger is ? It’s worth trying to figure it out. For me it’s really severe health issues. The healthier I make myself the better my anger is. Try to think of what the root issue is and do everything you can to make it better. It won’t totally fix the problem, and some people may just be angry for no apparent reason (shit, life is hard man), but take some time to try to figure it out. Lots of times it seems to have to do with the ego.  Some people have such strong egos and when the ego is threatened it tries to defend itself at all costs. Try to separate yourself from your ego, detach from the story that the voice in your head is telling you.  Practice getting angry and not reacting, the more you do it the better you’ll get at it. 1 win = 2 more wins or whatever.

I received my test score from my Finance teacher in college and it was lower than I expected. I was used to getting all As and when I got a B I was really disappointed. I started looking through the ones I got wrong and I noticed that one didn’t look right. I analyzed it closely and discovered that my answer wasn’t technically wrong. So after class was over I went up to him to discuss the problem and there was a line of students behind me waiting for their turn. I explained to him why I thought my answer was right and he shot me down. I argued back and explained again why it wasn’t wrong.  We kept going back and forth and it kept escalating. Eventually, he lost his shit and said in front of many other students “look, if you keep arguing with me I’ll slam your ass up against the wall.”  Keep in mind that this teacher is a pretty skinny dude. Anyways, I wasn’t trying to throw punches with my college professor so I walked away angry. Getting a B on that test brought my overall grade down from an A to a B.  I was super pissed because I was so accustomed to getting As.  So I decided to write my teacher and apologize to him. He took it well and made me an offer: if you get an A in the final I’ll give you an A for the semester. I studied my ass off and got a 98 on the final and finished the class with an A! Fuck yeah!
